role_assignment_note: AssignableScopes only defines where role may be assigned; actual role assignment MUST equal assignment_scope. Audit all inherited assignments as well.

source_authority.new_source_admission: Explicit reviewed source/release/expected-metric policy change. Never infer admission from a passing hash alone.

stages.name: validate
steps: Checkout trusted controls at workflow SHA; checkout source at explicit full SHA, no persisted checkout credential.
Require approved source/release mapping; run phase-004 source test gate with exact known-failure policy, worker tests and worker build.
Reconstruct existing ordered corpus-pins.json with indent=2 and terminal newline from all source bytes; require exact raw bytes and expected SHA.
Run original worker verify() for replay/materialization equivalence and exact metrics; both production flags false.
Upload immutable same-run validated bundle and test receipts; include source SHA, workflow SHA, release SHA and all file hashes.

stages.name: publish
steps: Run only reviewed control code. Download same-run bundle, bind immutable artifact ID/digest and recompute every manifest/file hash; never run source code in credentialed job.
Request GitHub OIDC with AzureADTokenExchange audience; verify exact repo, environment, job_workflow_ref and resulting sub before exchange.

Azure OIDC login as publisher only; prove principal/client/tenant and exact read+add role at exact container with no extra inherited authority. This bootstrap audit is recorded by a separate administrative reader; do not grant publisher roleAssignments/read/write.
Before first publication, verify auth-only read path and role operation contract. Denial testing must not touch an existing release; no claim of empirical write denial from local mocks.
Obtain Entra Storage bearer token, never Shared Key or SAS.
Complete paginated prefix list. Existing complete identical BlockBlob set => ALREADY_PUBLISHED, zero writes. Partial, extra or differing set => STOP.
Absent => single Put Blob BlockBlob, If-None-Match: *, no chunked Put Block/List, no write retry. Read back each payload; manifest last; complete list and read back all objects again.

Byte identity with locally semantically verified bundle establishes equivalence. Record source, release, artifact, workflow run, identity, object receipts, write attempts and outcome in durable artifact even on failure.
STOP. Never invoke deployment or promotion.

publish_vs_promote.promotion_path: existing phase-004 guarded pipeline after reviewed source/release policy admission
publish_vs_promote.compiled_trust_anchor: Worker image includes exact manifest; a new corpus release requires an image built from the matching approved manifest. Environment-only release switching is insufficient.

limitations: add/action also permits append to Append Blobs. Protocol creates and accepts only BlockBlob; verify existing release types read-only before authority assignment.
Container-scoped add may create additional names in existing prefixes. Complete-set check rejects extras; this is not a prefix-wide WORM lock.
Other principals/account keys are outside this publisher authority boundary; no storage immutability policy or legal hold is claimed.
Live OIDC/add-only API behavior and effective role readback remain gates before live publication.
deferred_hardening: Shared Key remains enabled; pipeline never uses it.
Public network remains enabled; no account changes in this phase.
